meta.author: 初中英國語文
meta.central_thesis: Choose responses that are both grammatically correct and polite for the situation.
title_lines: 帶交換生 Sam 遊香港一天。
用英文點餐、指路、介紹、講價；開啟語音後，可以直接讀出答案。

mentor.persona: 你的英文老師，會用中文解釋錯在哪裡

companion.persona: 剛從英國來港的交換生，對甚麼都好奇

rival.persona: 你的同學，說英文總是太隨便，常常犯錯

gatekeeper.persona: 每個場景結束時考你一題

scenes.title: 茶餐廳
scenes.intro_zh: 第一站帶 Sam 吃早餐。侍應很忙，要說得清楚又有禮貌。

turns.speaker: stranger
turns.line: Hi, what can I get you?

options.text: Could we have two cups of iced lemon tea and a pineapple bun, please?
Give me two iced lemon tea and pineapple bun.
options.why: 「Give me」對侍應太直接；飲品要說 two cups of iced lemon tea；pineapple bun 前面也漏了 a。

options.text: I want to eat two cups of iced lemon tea.
options.why: 飲品不能用 eat，要用 have 或 drink；而且 I want 不及 Could we have…, please? 有禮貌。

options.text: Two cup iced lemon tea, one pineapple bun.
options.why: cup 是可數名詞，兩杯要說 two cups of；整句只有名詞，沒有 please，語氣生硬。

turns.kenny: Give me two lemon tea lah!

turns.speaker: companion
turns.line: What's a pineapple bun? Is there pineapple in it?
turns.zh: 菠蘿包是甚麼？裡面有菠蘿嗎？

options.text: No, there isn't. It's called that because the top looks like a pineapple.
No, it don't have pineapple.
options.why: 主語 it 是第三身單數，要用 doesn't，不是 don't。

options.text: Pineapple bun is pineapple.
options.why: 這句意思錯誤，也沒有回答 Sam 的問題。要解釋名字的由來。

options.text: No, it isn't have pineapple.
options.why: is 和 have 不能一起用，應說 It doesn't have any pineapple。

options.text: Here you are. Can I pay by Octopus?
Forty-six? So expensive!
options.why: 對侍應抱怨價錢並不禮貌，而且沒有回應付款。

options.text: I pay by Octopus card, OK?
options.why: 詢問可否做某事，用 Can I...? 比較自然有禮；句末加 OK 聽起來像命令。

options.text: Here is it. Can I pay by Octopus?
options.why: 次序錯了，應說 Here it is 或 Here you are。

check.question: 在餐廳點餐，哪一個說法最有禮貌？
options: Could I have a cup of milk tea, please?
check.explain: Could I have…, please? 是點餐最常用、最有禮貌的句式。

scenes.title: 港鐵站
scenes.intro_zh: 你們在中環站，一位遊客走過來問路。可以點擊牆上的路線圖查看。

turns.speaker: stranger
turns.line: Excuse me, how do I get to Tsim Sha Tsui?

options.text: Take the Tsuen Wan Line towards Tsuen Wan. It's two stops from here.
You go red line, two stop.
options.why: 句子不完整：要用 Take the... Line，而且 two 之後要用複數 stops。

options.text: Take the Island Line to Tsim Sha Tsui.
options.why: 看看路線圖：港島綫只在香港島行駛，不經過尖沙咀。

options.text: Take the Tsuen Wan Line towards Central.
options.why: 你們已經在中環。方向要看列車的終點站，去尖沙咀應乘往荃灣方向的列車。

turns.kenny: Island Line lah, all the same!

turns.speaker: stranger
turns.line: Do I need to change trains?

options.text: No, you don't. It's a direct train.
No, you don't need change.
options.why: need 之後要加 to 再接動詞：need to change。

options.text: Yes, you must change at Kowloon Tong.
options.why: 從中環乘荃灣綫，可以直達尖沙咀，不用轉車。

options.text: No, you don't need to changing.
options.why: need to 之後要用動詞原形：need to change。

options.text: You're welcome. Enjoy your trip!
Welcome.
options.why: 單獨說 Welcome 是「歡迎光臨」的意思，回應道謝要說 You're welcome。

options.text: OK.
options.why: 只說 OK 太簡短冷淡，回應別人道謝應該更友善。

options.text: Never mind.
options.why: Never mind 用於回應道歉或表示「算了」，不是用來回應道謝。

check.question: 別人對你說 Thank you，最恰當的回應是？
check.explain: You're welcome 才是「不客氣」；Welcome 單獨使用是「歡迎」。

scenes.title: 天星小輪
scenes.intro_zh: 你們乘天星小輪過海，Sam 對維港的一切都很好奇。

turns.speaker: companion
turns.line: Wow, what's that tall building over there?
turns.zh: 嘩，那邊那幢很高的大廈是甚麼？

options.text: That's the ICC. It's the tallest building in Hong Kong.
That is ICC, it is most tall building in Hong Kong.
options.why: 形容詞 tall 的最高級是 the tallest，不是 most tall；ICC 前面也要加 the。

options.text: I don't know, who cares?
options.why: 對客人這樣回答很不禮貌。

options.text: That's the ICC. It's the most tallest building in Hong Kong.
options.why: 最高級不能同時用 most 和 -est，應說 the tallest。

turns.speaker: companion
turns.line: How long has the Star Ferry been running?

options.text: It has been running for over a hundred years.
It runs since 1888.
options.why: since 表示由過去持續到現在，要用現在完成式：has been running since 1888。

options.text: It has been running since a hundred years.
options.why: since 之後接時間點（例如 1888），一段時間要用 for：for a hundred years。

options.text: It has been run for over a hundred years.
options.why: 持續到現在的動作用 has been running；has been run 是被動語態，意思不對。

turns.kenny: It runs since long long ago!

turns.speaker: companion
turns.line: Shall we take a photo together?

options.text: Sure, that's a great idea!
Yes, I am agree.
options.why: agree 本身是動詞，不用加 am：I agree。

options.text: Photo? No need lah.
options.why: 對客人的邀請這樣回應太隨便，句末的 lah 是廣東話語氣詞，不是英文。

options.text: Sure, let's take photo.
options.why: photo 是可數名詞，前面要加冠詞：take a photo。

check.question: 以下哪一句是正確的？
options: It has been running for over a hundred years.
It has been running since a hundred years.
It run for a hundred years.
check.explain: 持續到現在的事用現在完成進行式；一段時間用 for，時間點用 since。

scenes.title: 街市
scenes.intro_zh: 最後一站，Sam 想買芒果。檔主會說一點英文，試試幫 Sam 講價。

turns.speaker: stranger
turns.line: Mangoes, twenty dollars each! Very sweet!
turns.zh: 芒果，每個二十元！很甜的！

options.text: Excuse me, could you give us a discount if we buy three?
Cheaper! Cheaper!
options.why: 只喊「平啲」既不禮貌，也沒有說清楚條件。

options.text: Could you give us a discount if we will buy three?
options.why: if 條件句說將來的事，if 子句用現在式：if we buy，不用 will。

options.text: Can you give discount?
options.why: discount 前面要加 a 或 us；而且 Could you…? 比 Can you…? 更有禮貌。

options.text: Great, that saves us five dollars. We'll take them.
Great, that saves us fifteen dollars.
options.why: 算一算：三個原價 60 元，現在 55 元，只省了 5 元。

options.text: Great, it are cheap.
options.why: it 要配 is：it is cheap。

options.text: Great, that save us five dollars.
options.why: that 是單數主語，動詞要加 s：that saves us。

turns.speaker: stranger
turns.line: Do you need a plastic bag?

options.text: No, thank you. We've brought our own bag.
No, thanks. We have brought our own bag yesterday.
options.why: 現在完成式不能和 yesterday 這類過去時間連用。

options.text: No need.
options.why: 只說 No need 太簡短生硬，加上 thank you 會有禮貌得多。

options.text: No, thank you. We bring our own bag.
options.why: 表示已經帶備了，要用現在完成式 We've brought；We bring 表示習慣。

check.question: 「Could you give us a discount if we buy three?」為甚麼用 buy 而不是 will buy？
options: if 條件句說將來的事時，if 子句用現在式
因為 buy 是不規則動詞
check.explain: 第一類條件句：if + 現在式，主句才用 will 或 can、could。

best.title: Excellent Buddy!
best.text: Sam 這一天玩得很開心，你的英文既正確又得體。

normal.title: Good Buddy
normal.text: 你帶 Sam 走完了一天，有幾句還可以說得更好。

fail.title: Keep Practising
fail.text: 有不少句子說錯了。看看短語簿，下次再試！

debrief: 好的英文不只是文法對，還要看場合：對陌生人用 Could I...? 和 please，回應道謝說 You're welcome，時態和單複數也要小心。
